about.text: The Chilean name for dulce de leche: a brown, sweet, pasty spread made mainly from milk and sugar heated for a long time until it caramelises and thickens. In Chile it is made to specific rules that require a minimum milk-solids content and a smooth texture.

facts.v: Manjar in Chile; 'manjar blanco' in Bolivia, Ecuador and Peru
Customs records show manjar imported into Argentina from Chile in 1693 and 1712
